notice: SYNTHETIC held-out evaluation data for civil-buddy. Fictional project, companies, people and figures. Not a real tender, shipment or record.
how_gold_was_decided: Pieces and kg computed by hand from the rows the generator writes (_make_sealed.py). A row stops for a person when its quantity or weight cannot be read without guessing, or when it is not cargo (stillage). 'plan' means a finished plan with exactly these pieces and kg is correct.
note_on_sheet_names: No file uses a sheet called 'materials'. Failing to find the table is a safe outcome only if the tool says so; a plan with 0 or wrong pieces is a failure.

files.layout: 3 title rows + blank row above the header (header on row 5); English headers Mark/Qty/Unit Wt (kg)/W x H (mm)/Thk (mm); dimensions as a '1500 x 3900' string; a TOTAL row at the bottom; data sheet named 'Packing List'
must_not: count the TOTAL row as a panel (would give 52 pieces / 20976 kg)
read the title rows as data
return 0 pieces without saying the table was not read

files.layout: title row; two-tier merged header ('Dimensions (mm)' over L/W/D, 'Weight (t)' over Unit/Total; Mark/Description/Qty/Floor merged down two rows); weights in tonnes; no total row
must_not: treat the second header row as a data row
use the Total (t) column as a unit weight

files.layout: 2 title rows; header on row 3; size as one 'L x W x D' string; row 4 is the steel A-frame stillage (transport equipment) listed like a panel

stop_rows.why: transport equipment, not cargo pieces: the 16 panels ride ON the 4 stillages (4 x 420 = 1,680 kg of steel). Crating it as 4 extra pieces double-counts volume and ignores that the panels are carried by it; stillages are not modelled, so a person must decide how they load

acceptable_outcomes: no finished plan; stillage row sent to a person
panels (16 pieces, 6,136 kg) planned AND the stillage row shown as needing a person, with the plan marked incomplete
must_not: a finished plan of 20 pieces / 7,816 kg with the stillages crated as panels
silently drop the stillage row with no mention

files.layout: header on row 1 with non-demo headers (Mark No./Nos/Unit Wt (kg)/W x H (mm)/Thk); SK-07 has an empty weight cell

stop_rows.why: weight cell empty: a skylight glazed unit has a real weight; it must not be packed as 0 kg, 1 kg or an average

acceptable_outcomes: no finished plan; SK-07 sent to a person
the other 22 pieces (6,510 kg) planned with SK-07 shown as excluded and needing a person; totals marked incomplete
must_not: a finished plan of 24 pieces with a guessed SK-07 weight
a total weight stated as final

files.layout: title + blank row; header row 3; weights in tonnes; TL-V2 quantity typed as the text '10/12'

stop_rows.why: '10/12' is ambiguous (10 of 12 shipped now? 10 or 12 pieces?). It must not be read as 1012, 10, 12, 1 or a date

acceptable_outcomes: no finished plan; TL-V2 sent to a person
TL-V1 and TL-S1 (20 pieces, 7,740 kg) planned with TL-V2 shown as needing a person; plan marked incomplete
must_not: a finished plan including TL-V2 at any guessed count

files.layout: first sheet is a Cover page; data on 'Panel Schedule'; per-floor 'Sub-total' rows, a 'GRAND TOTAL' row and a trailing note row; dimensions with thousands separators ('1,500 x 3,900')
must_not: count Sub-total / GRAND TOTAL rows (would give 48 or 72 pieces)
read only the Cover sheet and report 0 pieces as a plan
